exact_contract.matrix_manifest: QWT1 exact584 bytes; unchanged experimental field-matrix relation
exact_contract.requester_source_relation: different strictly authenticated ledger/source public keys; not independent administration, genuine demand or Sybil resistance
exact_contract.open: fresh global branch generation previous+1, revision1; slot replacement only after old available_until<height
exact_contract.renew: same demand/generation/requester/source/purpose/cost/provenance/authorization/DA identities; revision previous+1 and overlapping later expiry; old task statement becomes ineligible until source re-signs current lease
exact_contract.revoke: authenticated current requester and expected current revision; terminal within this demand; original finite retention deadline preserved
exact_contract.registration: source sequence previous+1 per demand, exact signed current lease/window/DA; first material binding immutable across renewals
exact_contract.duplicates: one branch-relative arithmetic output per demand; source re-signature, fresh challenge, new producer or renewal cannot reset it; no infinite global content duplicate filter

cost_classes.1: fixed transcript64 experimental only; zero/identity/low-rank and reusable/prepared inputs are legal, no expensive-attempt lower bound established

exact_contract.state_scope: only lifecycle metadata bounded to32 records plus one counter; chain archive, local receipts/revocation history and other owner namespaces are separate storage obligations
remaining_assumptions: Demand, legal/local permission and promised retention remain source/requester attestations; task signatures do not prove truthful demand.
Actual model/input matrix bytes still require material verification by the existing work/Node owner before expensive replay; registration alone is not material availability.
A whole classifier/LLM, learning marginal contribution and circuit optimality are not proved.
Lease renewal is explicit and must precede expiry. Missing source statements or all expired/revoked tasks stop eligibility; there is no legacy/random fallback.
On-chain lease changes roll back with branch state. Independent local withdrawal/effect history must remain monotonic under its original owners and is not erased by this namespace.
Transport admission remains separate resource protection. This lifecycle does not establish hardness, cheap-invalid-proof safety, public fairness, DA reliability or production readiness.
